Contributing to pksR

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

English | Deutsch

Thank you for helping to improve pksR. Bug reports, questions and pull requests are welcome.

Where to report what

  • The package (an error, a confusing message, a missing feature): open an issue at https://github.com/ofurkancoban/pksR/issues. Please include a small example that shows the problem and the output of sessionInfo().
  • The data (a wrong value, a missing district or year, a wrong offence label): open an issue at https://github.com/ofurkancoban/pksR-data/issues. Please name the data version (attr(d, "data_version")), year, district code (ags) and offence key, and if you can, the value in the original BKA table.

Pull requests

  1. Open an issue first for anything larger than a typo, so we can agree on the approach.
  2. Fork the repository and create a branch from main.
  3. Add or update tests in tests/testthat/. Tests run offline: they use the fixture release in tests/testthat/fixtures/release and never contact GitHub or the BKA.
  4. Run devtools::document(), devtools::test() and devtools::check() before you push.
  5. Use Conventional Commits for commit messages and the pull request title, for example fix(api): keep Berlin in the example panel. Types: feat, fix, data, docs, test, refactor, perf, build, ci, chore, revert.

Style

  • Code, comments, commit messages and file names are in English.
  • Call functions of other packages with pkg::fun().
  • Messages go through cli and are wrapped in tr(). After adding or changing a message, run Rscript data-raw/translations.R and add the German text to inst/i18n/de.po.
  • Documentation is bilingual: every help page has a @section Deutsch:, and each vignette has a German version (*-de.Rmd).
  • Do not use em dashes or en dashes; use colons, commas or parentheses.

Code of conduct

Please be kind and constructive. We follow the rOpenSci Code of Conduct.

Deutsch

Danke, dass Sie pksR verbessern möchten.

  • Fehler im Paket melden Sie unter https://github.com/ofurkancoban/pksR/issues, mit einem kleinen Beispiel und sessionInfo().
  • Fehler in den Daten melden Sie unter https://github.com/ofurkancoban/pksR-data/issues, mit Datenversion, Jahr, Kreisschlüssel (ags), Straftatenschlüssel und, wenn möglich, dem Wert in der BKA-Tabelle.
  • Pull Requests: zuerst ein Issue öffnen, Tests ergänzen (sie laufen ohne Internet), vor dem Push devtools::check() ausführen, Commit-Nachrichten nach Conventional Commits. Code und Commits sind auf Englisch; Meldungen bekommen ihre deutsche Übersetzung in inst/i18n/de.po, Hilfeseiten einen Abschnitt Deutsch.
